outOfScope: Changing delivered product/Core/Oracle semantics or benchmark thresholds after results.
Treating public benchmark scores, vendor claims or selected demos as ExHarness product-value evidence.
Forcing a fake direct-agent analogue for lifecycle capabilities that only the delivery product exposes.
Implementing BB-075 HOW improvements or BB-076 release acceptance.
constraints: Worker binds exact DONE BB-065/071/073/077/081 artifacts plus the supported release/profile; missing or incompatible bindings => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

External comparison holds model/provider, task digest/instruction, start environment, tool surface, aggregate provider/token/time ceilings, final verifier and reset policy fixed; only DIRECT_CODEACT vs supported ExHarness delivery orchestration varies.

External cohort is sealed before model results: six primary + two ordered reserve Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks, all unused by BB-077/081; reserve substitution is allowed only for failed oracle/nop preflight before any live arm dispatch.
Every primary task runs two repeats per arm = 24 registered arm units. Fresh sandbox/runtime/provider session is required per unit; all attempts/retries/failures remain recorded.
Human effort is measured only from explicit operator events. Idle/tool/provider time is never inferred as active effort; zero effort requires an explicit NO_INTERVENTION record.
Benchmark setup and independent evaluator time are excluded from product human effort; operator review/decision/coordination/manual repair are included and manual edits are marked human-assisted.
Quality remains independent-verifier owned. Producer success, human perception, runtime success or model termination cannot accept delivery.

Primary value gates are frozen before live results: ExHarness accepted-unit rate >= Direct; zero critical escaped defects; total operator active time <=80% of Direct; provider cost per accepted delivery <=110% of Direct; all required lifecycle scenarios pass.
Unknown primary provider cost, missing human-event coverage, missing registered unit, task/verifier/profile drift or incomplete lifecycle evidence => INCONCLUSIVE, never value demonstrated.
Lead time, repeat consistency, failure fingerprints and perceived ease are reported diagnostics; no opaque composite score or arbitrary dollar conversion of human time is permitted.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Reuse BB-077 Harbor substrate, DIRECT_CODEACT control, provider/measurement/failure contracts and exact supported Core profile selected by BB-081. BB-074 adds delivery orchestration and human-effort measurement; it does not redefine harness accounting.

D2 — External arm E is the exact supported ExHarness release/profile from BB-073+BB-081; arm D is BB-077 DIRECT_CODEACT. Both receive the same Terminal-Bench instruction/environment/final verifier and aggregate live budget.

D3 — Freeze six external primary tasks: configure-git-webserver, git-multibranch, build-cython-ext, modernize-scientific-stack, custom-memory-heap-crash, sqlite-with-gcov. Ordered reserves are openssl-selfsigned-cert then db-wal-recovery; all digests are pinned in externalCohort.

D4 — Before any live model call, each primary/reserve candidate used must pass Harbor oracle 5/5 and nop fail 1/1. Substitution follows reserve order and is sealed in one cohort hash before arm results.

D5 — Run two repeats per task/arm. Counterbalance D/E order across 12 task-repeat pairs; fresh task environment, product/direct runtime state and provider session per unit. A retry is a new attempt inside the same unit.

D6 — Give both arms the same aggregate ceiling: USD1.20 provider cost, 360k input tokens, 24k output tokens, 24 model turns, 96 host/tool calls and 1800s wall time per registered arm unit; live external cohort ceiling is USD35.

D7 — Record DELIVERY_HUMAN_EVENT_V1 with explicit START/PAUSE/RESUME/STOP or NO_INTERVENTION. Included categories are OPERATOR_REVIEW, PRODUCT_DECISION, COORDINATION and MANUAL_EDIT; excluded categories are BENCHMARK_SETUP, INDEPENDENT_EVAL and PASSIVE_WAIT.

D8 — Primary active human effort is the union duration of included operator intervals per unit; overlapping categories are not double-counted and overlapping active intervals across units are forbidden. Manual edits remain visible and final quality still comes from the same independent verifier.

D9 — Lifecycle evidence is separate from the causal D/E task comparison. Run six exact delivered-product scenarios derived from BB-071/073: local requirement change, cross-domain requirement change, kill/resume+duplicate activation, stale-worker/deployment fence, clean install+reference delivery, upgrade/rollback compatibility.

D10 — Lifecycle scenarios report active human effort, lead time, provider cost when live, recovery/fencing result and independent acceptance. No direct-arm symmetry is invented where the capability does not exist.

D11 — Use a deterministic reducer with outcomes VALUE_DEMONSTRATED, NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED or INCONCLUSIVE. Complete evidence + any primary gate failure => NO_VALUE; incomplete/unknown/drift => INCONCLUSIVE.

D12 — Human perception is diagnostic only. An optional post-unit ease/confidence rating may be collected, but it cannot override observed active time, verifier quality or economics; this avoids perception-as-productivity substitution.
D13 — BB-075 may consume observed bottlenecks/failure fingerprints only after BB-074 freezes and publishes this value result. BB-076 later reproduces the exact release and value profile.
implementationSlices: S1 — Bind exact DONE benchmark/product dependencies and supported release/profile; seal fixed-factor arm manifests.
S2 — Preflight and seal six external held-out tasks plus ordered reserves before any live arm dispatch.
S3 — Implement explicit human-event ledger and unit lifecycle with fresh D/E environments and complete attempt/provider accounting.
S4 — Run 24 external registered arm units and produce paired quality/economics/human-effort/lead-time/failure evidence.
S5 — Run six product lifecycle scenarios from BB-071/073 and capture recovery/fencing/install/rollback plus human effort.
S6 — Reduce complete evidence to VALUE_DEMONSTRATED, NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED or INCONCLUSIVE with frozen gates.
S7 — Publish report and update Living truth with only the verified value result, limitations and exact release/protocol bindings.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Worker binds exact DONE BB-065/071/073/077/081 outputs and one supported release/profile; stale/missing/incompatible inputs fail before live dispatch.
Exactly six sealed primary tasks, two repeats and D/E arms form 24 registered units under identical fixed factors; reserve replacement occurs only after preflight and before results.
All attempts/retries/provider failures and nullable token/cost fields remain append-only and bound to registered units; no success-only filtering or unknown-to-zero conversion occurs.
Primary human effort derives only from explicit included DELIVERY_HUMAN_EVENT_V1 intervals, with excluded benchmark/evaluator/wait time separated and zero requiring NO_INTERVENTION.
Both arms use the same independent final verifier; ExHarness accepted-unit rate is no lower than Direct and critical escaped defects are zero.
Primary value requires ExHarness total operator active time <=80% of Direct and provider cost per accepted delivery <=110% of Direct under complete known accounting.
All six delivered-product lifecycle scenarios pass their independent acceptance/fencing/recovery expectations and report active effort, elapsed time and cost/status without invented direct symmetry.
Frozen reducer emits only VALUE_DEMONSTRATED, NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED or INCONCLUSIVE; complete primary failure is NO_VALUE and incomplete/unknown/drift is INCONCLUSIVE.
Benchmark/run/runtime success cannot become product, QA, publication or external-effect authority.
Every result binds exact release/source/task/attempt/configuration/evidence and unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
Outer Blackboard remains ExHarness-development control; benchmark tooling does not become product-runtime coordination.

researchGaps: Refresh BB-074 to consume the shared @exharness/benchmark kernel and delivered upstream comparison contracts; the previous READY plan predates BB-065/BB-077 ownership.
negativeVerificationCases: A BB-077/081 development or held-out task is reused in the BB-074 external cohort.
Reserve substitution occurs after any live arm result is observed.
D/E arms differ in model/provider/task/environment/tool surface/budget/final verifier.
A retry replaces an earlier failed attempt or unknown token/cost fields become zero.
Human effort is inferred from idle/tool/provider time or an unlogged run is treated as zero intervention.
Benchmark setup or independent evaluator time is counted as product operator effort.
Manual edit is hidden while final candidate is reported as fully autonomous.
ExHarness is called value-demonstrated with lower accepted rate, a critical escaped defect, >80% Direct active effort, >110% Direct cost/accepted, or failed lifecycle scenario.
Incomplete cost/event/unit/lifecycle evidence is converted to NO_VALUE or VALUE instead of INCONCLUSIVE.
Downstream BB-075/076 or producer narrative changes thresholds or overrides the reducer.
